note_id.field: note_id of the note describing the trips' who-owes-whom information

calls.pddl: (splitwise-record-expense description-a1 amount-a1 payer-a1-email debtors-a1 splitwise-token debt-amounts-a1 group-trip-a expense-a1 note-trips)

description.field: content: description of expense 1 of trip A

paid_amount.field: content: total paid amount of expense 1 of trip A

payer_email.field: members[].email of the person the note names as payer of expense 1 of trip A (supervisor's own email if she paid)

debtor_emails.field: list of members[].email for each person the note says owes on expense 1 of trip A

debt_amounts.field: content: amount each debtor owes on expense 1 of trip A, same order as debtors-a1

group_id.field: group_id of the group whose name matches the first trip in the note
